name: lcd-spec
description: Spec workflow on top of OpenSpec with hard gates: dialogue design, grilling of every decision, a detailed TDD plan, a pre-apply audit of every claim against the code, subagent-driven implementation with a review per task, and archiving that keeps specs, transcripts and plans together. Tracks project mistakes in openspec/incidents.md, including frustration signals (UA/RU/EN) from the user.
